recipe: Wan 2.1 1.3B video on a Max-Q card via a lease-holding job
note: Fields starting with an underscore are private and removed by check_recipes.py before anything is published.

receipts.claim: Wan 2.1 T2V 1.3B, 21 frames (1.31 s at 16 fps), 480x832, 30 steps, warm
receipts.value: median 26.0 s per clip over 22 clips (range 24.9 to 53.1 s; the 53.1 s clip carried the model load); mean 27.0 s
receipts.caveat: Run by a lease-holding job under an external pacing script (pause 88 C, resume 84 C); no pause occurred. 22 rendered, 0 failed, 0 abandoned in 862 s of job wall time. Sub-second spread is not significant: one prompt list, fixed seeds.

receipts.claim: Same model, 41 frames (2.56 s, the runner maximum)
receipts.value: 77.3 s and 51.7 s for two clips; mean 64.5 s
receipts.caveat: Two clips, no more. GPU peak 86 to 87 C, within 4 to 5 C of the pause line.

receipts.claim: Warm production-path timing from a separate run
receipts.value: 26.6 to 27.2 s for 21 frames, 52.8 s for 41 frames, 56.1 s with model load (about 29 s)
receipts.caveat: Through the media service rather than the job. GPU start 68 to 72 C, peak 80 to 83 C (21 frames) and 86 C (41 frames). Seed fixed.

receipts.value: about 3 s of video per GPU minute warm (1.3B)
9 frames (0.56 s) in 112.5 s including load; 0.3 s of video per GPU minute; GPU peak 85 C; whole-card memory 68.9 GB
receipts.caveat: One cold run. CPU temperature touched 85.25 C for one sample and the in-flight request could not be cancelled, so this is a completed clip with a guardrail excursion, not a clean pass. Warm 14B was not measured.

receipts.claim: Clip format limits of the runner
receipts.value: 480x832 (the width/height label is swapped: asking 832x480 gives portrait), 16 fps, 30 steps fixed, frames = 4 x duration + 1, duration 2 to 10 so at most 41 frames
receipts.caveat: The model natively makes 81 frames; this runner does not expose that.

receipts.value: 14.9 to 20.0 GB whole-card for 21 frames; 60.3 GB for the 41-frame clip
receipts.caveat: Whole-card memory.used includes about 1.9 GB of desktop. The runner reports 13 GB, which under-reports by 4 to 5x.

receipts.value: a blocking waiter on the lock file gets the card in about 1.4 s; the displaced job lost 344 s and 42 s of work in two hand-overs
receipts.caveat: The displaced job restarted from the beginning of its run (it does not resume mid-run).
The job skips clips it already has (same prompt id, frame count, seed), so interruptions cost little.

receipts.claim: Admission service refused a clip while the lease was held elsewhere
receipts.caveat: This is why the job starts its own runner under the lease instead of calling the service.

receipts.value: Wan 2.1 T2V 1.3B, Apache-2.0; commit id not recorded (a checksum manifest exists, a commit id does not)
receipts.caveat: Revision gap: the pull was by repository name; fix by recording the commit id before publishing a pin.

receipts.value: motion quality review (one frame per clip checked for the 5 clips of the production-path run, none for the 22), other seeds, other resolutions, 81-frame clips, 14B warm
receipts.caveat: These are short clips from fixed prompts and a visual spot check, not a video quality evaluation.
